name: Workflows (IGA)
description: Visual IGA workflow scenarios: build a graph of steps, run it, follow every step. Simulated steps (wait, notification, deliberate failure) never have an external effect; real data steps write on the run's own Dolt branch; publishing to main always stays a human merge. While disabled, the Workflows menu is hidden and every /workflows* endpoint answers 403.

mailTemplates.name: Workflow notification
mailTemplates.description: Sent by a workflow's notify step. Simulated in this demo (nothing sent) unless a real notifier serves notify.default.
